summary: Blind Adjacent Profile Review: the HM advanced 7 of 10 adjacent candidates with programming language and current title hidden.
observations: 7 of 10 adjacent candidates were advanced by the HM when language and current title were hidden.
Of the 7 advanced: 2 Rust, 2 C++, 2 Java, 1 Go.
Advanced candidates' current titles included Senior Engineer, Principal Engineer, Tech Lead and Staff Engineer.
3 of 10 were declined on demonstrated scope or systems depth, not on language or title.
